hints.title: Element as Subarray Minimum
hints.text: Consider each element nums[i] as the minimum of the subarray and extend as far as possible in both directions.

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Boundary Detection
hints.text: Use a monotonic stack to find the previous smaller element on the left and the next smaller element on the right.

hints.title: Prefix Sum for Range Total
hints.text: Calculate subarray sums in constant time using prefix sums and maximize the min-product before applying modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding subarrays around each element naively takes O(n^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack finds left and right bounds in O(n) time, enabling linear prefix sum evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes max product using 64-bit integers and applies modulo 10^9 + 7 only at the end.
